name: Fatal Focus
source:
You have recently moved into a small town in Pennsylvania. In your lonesome, you sign up for a photography walk through town, hoping to meet some new friends. The only patrons are you and Adonis, a mysterious photographer, whose fingers are deep in the town's soil, digging up its history and its ghosts.

[From [url=https://catsket.itch.io/fatalfocus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你最近搬到了宾夕法尼亚州的一座小镇。孤独之中，你报名参加了穿行小镇的摄影漫步，希望结识新朋友。参与者却只有你，以及神秘的摄影师阿多尼斯。他深入挖掘这座小镇的土地，探寻其历史与幽灵。

[摘自[url=https://catsket.itch.io/fatalfocus]itch.io[/url]]
